card.name: Unit after per-dose amount limits
card.fires_on: The unit or noun right after a quantity in a per-dose limit, such as 'not to exceed 0.1 mg' or 'up to 500 mg'. It also fires on 'each' and 'one' phrases such as 'wear only one patch'.
